Run python unit3-secure-networks-model.py using Python 3; standard library only, offline, no sockets/configuration changes. Functions predict a deliberately simplified NEW cross-zone policy and decimal-unit ideal capacity. Same-zone traffic, state, DNS/DHCP, management, address authenticity and actual firewall enforcement are outside this model.
Workbook/brief are student resources; answers are separate but not access-protected. SVGs are original conceptual diagrams. Cisco convention symbol-identification/redraw is required in the student activity; validate fidelity with the official reference before assessed use.
Sources linked in chapter: SCSA 2026 Year 12 syllabus network components/performance; ASD September 2026 ISM networking; Microsoft ping/tracert; Cisco topology icons.
